title: 家长投诉与道歉
goal: 家长不满意时，能先道歉、表示理解，再说你会怎么处理。

chunks.note: 家长不高兴时，第一句先道歉。
让对方觉得你在听、你理解，很能让人消气。

chunks.en: Can you tell me what happened?
chunks.zh: 能告诉我发生了什么吗？

chunks.note: I'll = I will，意思是"我会……""我来……"。

chunks.en: We will call you back today.
chunks.zh: 我们今天会给您回电话。

chunks.note: 结束时说，家长会觉得被尊重。

drill.zh: 我会/我来……（告诉对方你接下来会做什么）

dialogue.title: 作业没有批改
dialogue.setting: 一位家长来到前台，说她儿子的作业上周没有被批改，有点不高兴。

npc.en: Hi, my son's homework was not marked last week.
npc.zh: 你好，我儿子上周的作业没有批改。

replies.en: I understand. Let me check for you.

npc.en: His name is Ethan. He is in the Primary 3 class.
npc.zh: 他叫 Ethan，在小学三年级的班。

replies.en: Thank you. Please wait a moment.

npc.en: This is the second time, you know.

replies.en: I'm sorry. It won't happen again.
I understand. I'll tell the teacher.

npc.zh: 老师能给我打个电话吗？

replies.en: Yes, we will call you back today.
replies.zh: 可以，我们今天会给您回电话。

replies.en: Yes. Thank you for telling us.

npc.en: OK, thank you. I'll wait for the call.

task: 今天如果有家长来问问题或者不满意，先说一句 I understand. 或者 Let me check for you.
